system.name: MegaStation
system.one_liner: a single-node supercomputer that treats massive MIMO baseband processing as instructions dynamically scheduled over a composable GPU pool

components.name: RUs (1...n)
components.role: radio units supplying frame sequences of IQ samples as input

components.name: Instruction Unit
components.role: translates incoming frame data into per-GPU instruction queues

components.name: GPU1
components.role: instruction queue destined for a specific GPU

components.name: GPU2
components.role: instruction queue destined for a specific GPU

components.name: GPUn
components.role: instruction queue destined for a specific GPU

components.name: Pipeline Schedulers
components.role: dispatch queued instructions to available GPU executors based on committed status

components.name: GPUs (1...n)
components.role: pool of composable GPU executors that run dispatched instructions

components.name: exe
components.role: an executor slot within a GPU; shaded when currently occupied by an instruction

components.name: The Scoreboarding
components.role: centralized bookkeeper tracking instruction execution status and GPU resource occupancy

components.name: Instructions
components.role: record of issued instructions tracked by the scoreboarding

components.name: Executors
components.role: record of executor occupancy tracked by the scoreboarding

components.name: Frame i
components.role: one radio frame of IQ samples selected for instruction generation

components.name: Instruction Stream
components.role: ordered list of per-symbol processing instructions generated for a frame

components.name: <Frame i, Symbol 0, PilotFFT>
components.role: example instruction: pilot-symbol FFT for channel estimation

components.name: <Frame i, Symbol 0, ZF>
components.role: example instruction: zero-forcing beamforming using the pilot's channel estimate

components.name: <Frame i, Symbol j, FFT>
components.role: example instruction: FFT of an uplink/downlink data symbol

components.name: <Frame i, Symbol j, EqDemodul>
components.role: example instruction: equalization and demodulation depending on the FFT and beamforming outputs

components.name: <Frame i, Symbol j, Decode>
components.role: example instruction: channel decoding following equalization/demodulation

components.name: L:exe
components.role: a node in the per-frame instruction dependency DAG, annotated with its estimated execution latency

components.name: OpcodeInfoTable
components.role: stores each opcode's resource vector and average execution latency, one table per GPU type

components.name: InstStatusTable
components.role: tracks each instruction's issue, execution, and commit timestamps

components.name: GPUStatTable
components.role: tracks, per GPU, which executors are planned, their estimated lifetime, and completion flags

content.key_idea: MegaStation treats baseband processing as instructions: an Instruction Unit turns radio frames into a per-symbol dependency DAG, a scoreboard tracks per-opcode and per-GPU state, and schedulers dispatch ready instructions onto composable GPUs.
content.reading_order: Panel (a) left-to-right (RUs into Instruction Unit, Schedulers, GPUs, Scoreboarding below); then (b) and (c) zoom into instruction-to-DAG translation and the scoreboard's tables.

summary: Figure 7 combines an overview of MegaStation's architecture (a) with two detail panels (b, c). In (a), Radio Units feed frame sequences into an Instruction Unit that queues per-GPU instructions, Pipeline Schedulers dispatch them onto a pool of composable GPU executors ('exe' slots, shaded when busy), and a Scoreboarding component tracks both instruction and executor state below. Panel (b) shows how a selected frame's pilot/uplink/downlink symbols are decoded into an Instruction Stream (e.g. PilotFFT, ZF, FFT, EqDemodul, Decode), whose read-after-write dependencies are traced with orange curves into a DAG of latency-annotated nodes. Panel (c) details the three tables the Scoreboarding maintains: an OpcodeInfoTable of per-opcode latency/resource vectors, an InstStatusTable of issue/exec/commit timestamps, and a GPUStatTable of planned executors, estimated lifetime, and completion flags per GPU.
